docker.environment_note: OUR_ENV=local allows container-local loopback source; deployment is proven by container provenance, not CLI execution.deployment label.

warnings: Google api_core Python3.11 EOL FutureWarning, also present in baseline runs

native_dependencies_note: psutil7.1.3 installed into campaign-only target; original Windows environment had7.1.0. Same isolated target and documented CloudFiles patch for both tested revisions. No global or shipped dependency changed.
scope_notes: Identical uint16 raw voxel data within and across platforms; representative crop is first six original Posterior Salivary Duct2 points with original coordinates/700nm spacing.
Only within-platform before/after timing comparisons; raw source backend differs by platform. Full remote sharded download campaign is not timed.
No production instrumentation: existing benchmark.run_once and TIFF evidence, canonical RAM collector, manager allocation/release and existing resident_bytes are reused.
Original and modified production Python file hashes and benchmark harness hash are in platform results. Reproduction driver optional output-root argument was added for native NTFS outputs.

All per-run canonical statistics retained, including memory status/sampling coverage and worker timings. Short runs and incomplete sweeps can miss phase peaks; allocation size reduction is not a whole-pipeline RAM guarantee.
Windows allocation JSON line endings were normalized from CRLF to LF for repository publication; parsed values are unchanged and original capture hashes are retained separately.
